summary_en: 6,000 shares (0.15% of shares outstanding) to be acquired gratuitously and cancelled following termination of employee stock grant trust. Acquisition date 2026-07-01, cancellation date 2026-07-31. Shares held in trust by Japan Custodian Bank.
summary_jp: 従業員向け株式給付信託の終了に伴い、6,000株（発行済株式総数の0.15%）を無償取得・消却。2026年7月1日に取得、7月31日に消却。日本カストディ銀行（信託口）が保有。
